taxonomy.connected_piece_loss: The expanding union of three overlapping elliptical lobes along a diagonal; one irregular connected lost piece, possibly edge-clipped.
taxonomy.corner_loss: A corner-anchored expanding rectangle, guarded from the two opposite edges; exactly two adjacent edges touched.
taxonomy.edge_loss: A straight boundary slab, inset one pixel from the two neighboring edges; exactly one edge touched.
taxonomy.edge_tear: A connected boundary loss with a two-frequency depth profile, inset from neighboring edges; a varying inward front.
taxonomy.internal_hole: An expanding elliptical interior hole, with a one-pixel border guard; no page edge touched.
taxonomy.strip_loss: A full-span vertical or horizontal strip, positioned at the start, middle or end of the transverse axis.

zero_detection_policy: include_page_metrics; region_survival_undefined; never infer absent content
